pages.title: Operator commands
pages.text: /ss (alias /simplyspeakers) offers network listing, info and playback control.$(br2)Target a network name or a speaker position.$(br2)Commands require operator access.

pages.title: Control options
pages.text: Commands support play, pause, stop, restart, next, previous, seek, volume, range, shuffle and repeat.$(br2)Display names identify networks; Speaker IDs link blocks.

pages.title: Java integration
pages.text: SpeakerApi is the server-side control API; call it on the server thread and enforce actor permissions.$(br2)SpeakerEvents exposes playback changes for integrations.
